meta.actor: Claude — consolidation pass (no research, no content rewriting)
meta.scope: Every Grok batch file for Venezuela merged into one file. Records are byte-faithful to the batches except for the normalisations listed in _consolidation.

reports.title: Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE) — institutional statistical identity
reports.description: National statistical office. Formal producer of official demographic, social and economic statistics. Publication cadence and methodological transparency have been severely constrained for an extended period.
reports._notes: Institutional parent node. Continuously cited as the formal statistical authority, but the practical data environment for poverty, labour and living conditions has been dominated by independent sources for years.
_referenced_by: International organisations that still cite residual official series

reports.title: Encuesta Nacional de Condiciones de Vida (ENCOVI) — UCAB
reports.description: Independent multi-purpose household survey conducted by the Universidad Católica Andrés Bello. Primary source for income poverty, multidimensional poverty, labour, education, health, services and migration effects used by domestic and international analysis.
reports._notes: De-facto core household-welfare survey. Annual (or near-annual) since the mid-2010s. Continuously cited as the reference series for poverty, services access and living conditions when official publication is sparse. Recent rounds place income poverty in the high 60s % of households and multidimensional poverty around the mid-50s %.

reports.title: Pobreza de ingresos (ENCOVI)
reports.description: Income-poverty and extreme-poverty incidence derived from the ENCOVI household survey. Headline monetary-poverty indicator used in external analysis.
reports._notes: Headline social indicator under data-quality constraints. Recent ENCOVI rounds show income poverty still very high (order of 65–70% of households) with extreme poverty (inability to cover food) remaining material (order of 30%+ of households in recent readings).

reports.title: Pobreza multidimensional (ENCOVI)
reports.description: Multidimensional poverty index combining income with deprivations in employment, housing, public services and education. Complementary structural poverty measure.
reports._notes: Structural poverty measure. Has been more sticky than income poverty in recent years; public-service failures (electricity, water) weigh heavily. Recent readings around the mid-50s % of the population.

reports.title: Banco Central de Venezuela — statistical publications
reports.description: Central-bank statistical output covering monetary aggregates, prices, external accounts and related macroeconomic series. Publication and methodological transparency have varied sharply over the crisis period.
reports._notes: Formal monetary and external statistical authority. Residual official series on inflation, exchange rates and external accounts remain the starting point for macroeconomic analysis, often cross-checked against independent estimates.

reports.title: Índice de Precios al Consumidor / Inflation statistics
reports.description: Consumer price index and inflation measures. Official BCV series coexist with independent estimates that have been widely used during periods of high inflation and publication gaps.
reports._notes: Flagship price statistic under data-quality stress. Hyperinflation episode and subsequent high inflation made independent price tracking (and later official stabilisation) central to any reading of real incomes and poverty.

reports.title: CLAP — Comité Local de Abastecimiento y Producción (food boxes)
reports.description: State subsidised food-distribution programme delivering periodic food boxes to households. Major non-income support instrument in the crisis and post-hyperinflation period.
reports._notes: Lived social-protection node. ENCOVI and other sources consistently report very high coverage (often 80%+ of households receiving boxes at some frequency). Complements (and partially substitutes for) cash income in food access.
reports._url_evidence: Asamblea Nacional official law page for the Ley Constitucional del CLAP (sanctioned 5 Jan 2018, Gaceta Oficial 41.330), which constitutes and regulates the CLAP food-distribution committees; no Venezuelan ministry publishes a live CLAP programme/statistics landing page.

reports.title: Acceso a servicios públicos (electricidad, agua)
reports.description: Household access to continuous electricity and piped water. Core component of multidimensional poverty and of everyday living conditions.
reports._notes: Lived infrastructure failure node. Recent ENCOVI rounds indicate continuous electricity is available to only a small minority of households and continuous piped water to a minority; service interruptions are a defining feature of daily life for most.

reports.title: Migración y población residual
reports.description: Statistics and estimates of large-scale emigration and of the residual resident population. Demographic context for all household and labour analysis.
reports._notes: Structural demographic shock. Millions have left; residual population estimates (ENCOVI and others) are substantially below earlier official projections (order of 28–29 million vs earlier 34 million projections). Shapes labour supply, dependency ratios and the interpretation of all household surveys.

reports.title: Distrito Capital / Caracas — metropolitan core
reports.description: Capital metropolitan area. Primary urban domain for labour, income, services and poverty analysis.
reports._notes: Dominant metro node. Continuously appears as a distinct geographic domain in ENCOVI and residual official tabulations; service and labour conditions remain stressed even in the capital.

reports.title: Producción petrolera / Oil production
reports.description: Crude-oil production volumes. Structural backbone of the external accounts and fiscal capacity. Recent recovery from the deep trough of the late 2010s / early 2020s.
reports._notes: Core external-revenue node. Production has recovered toward the 1.0–1.2 million barrels/day range in recent readings (highest in several years) but remains far below historical peaks. Continuously cited as the primary driver of any macroeconomic rebound.

reports.title: Petróleos de Venezuela (PDVSA)
reports.description: State oil company. Producer, exporter and fiscal contributor of the hydrocarbon sector.
reports._notes: Institutional parent of the oil economy. Operational and financial condition has been central to the external and fiscal crisis; recovery of production is inseparable from PDVSA’s capacity and from external commercial arrangements.

reports.title: Balanza de Pagos / Balance of Payments
reports.description: Balance of payments covering the current account, capital/financial account and reserve changes. Publication and detail have varied over the crisis period.
reports._notes: Core external-accounts product under data-quality stress. Oil exports dominate the goods account; remittances and other secondary income are material supporting flows.

reports.title: Reservas internacionales / International reserves
reports.description: Stock of international reserve assets. Key external-buffer indicator under chronic foreign-exchange pressure.
reports._notes: External-buffer node. Levels remain low relative to historical peaks and to the economy’s import and debt-service needs; exchange-market intervention draws on available reserves.

reports.title: Tipo de cambio / Exchange rate
reports.description: Official and parallel exchange rates. Central relative price in a dual (or multi) exchange-rate environment that shapes inflation, real incomes and import access.
reports._notes: Lived price signal. Large and persistent gaps between official and parallel rates have been a defining feature of the crisis; recent periods show rapid official depreciation and high inflation pass-through.

reports.title: Cobertura y asistencia escolar (ENCOVI)
reports.description: School enrolment and attendance indicators from the independent household survey. Complements residual official education statistics.
reports._notes: Lived education gap. Coverage remains below pre-crisis levels; a large absolute number of children are out of school, and irregular attendance (2–3 days/week) is widespread among those enrolled.

reports.title: Empleo y ocupación (ENCOVI)
reports.description: Labour-force participation, occupation and formal/informal employment indicators from ENCOVI. Primary labour-market window under official-data constraints.
reports._notes: Lived labour market. Occupation rates are low by regional standards; female participation is especially depressed. Formal employment share has risen from crisis lows but remains limited; self-employment and informal work absorb much of the adjustment.

reports.title: Remesas / Family remittances
reports.description: Inflows of personal transfers from Venezuelans living abroad. Major secondary-income and household-support flow.
reports._notes: Lived external support. Remittances partially offset domestic income shortfalls for receiving households; ENCOVI tracks both the share of households that receive them and changes in sending behaviour among the diaspora.

reports.title: Bonos y transferencias monetarias del Estado
reports.description: State cash bonuses and transfers that supplement household income alongside CLAP food boxes.
reports._notes: Lived social-protection node. Coverage is wide but amounts are small in real terms; ENCOVI analysis has noted that transfers are not strongly progressive (non-poor households also receive them).

reports.title: Faja Petrolífera del Orinoco — resource base
reports.description: World’s largest known extra-heavy oil resource. Geographic and geological core of Venezuela’s long-run petroleum potential.
reports._notes: Foundational resource node. Continuously cited as the physical base of proven reserves (order of 300 billion barrels) and of any sustained recovery scenario; requires specialised technology and large investment to develop at scale.

reports.title: Estado Zulia — western oil and population pole
reports.description: Western state centred on Maracaibo. Largest state population mass and a major oil-producing region. High service and living-condition stress in independent surveys.
reports._notes: Demographic and oil-geography node. Continuously appears among the highest-stress states in independent living-conditions diagnostics; large absolute population affected by service failures and poverty.

reports.title: Estado Miranda — capital-region periphery
reports.description: State surrounding and interwoven with the Caracas metro. Large population, mixed urban conditions, and high absolute poverty and service-stress counts.
reports._notes: Completes the greater Caracas statistical geography. Frequently ranked among the largest absolute poverty and service-deprivation masses.

reports.title: Estado Bolívar — southern mining and industrial
reports.description: Southern state with major mining (iron, gold, etc.) and industrial activity (Ciudad Guayana). Distinct resource and living-conditions profile.
reports._notes: Mining and heavy-industry geography. Independent diagnostics show elevated multidimensional stress; resource extraction coexists with severe service and income gaps.

reports.title: Estado Carabobo — central industrial corridor
reports.description: Central state with significant industrial and commercial activity (Valencia area). Intermediate-to-high living-condition stress.
reports._notes: Industrial-corridor node. Completes the set of major population and economic poles outside the pure oil west and the capital.

reports.title: Sistema de salud — acceso y deficiencias
reports.description: Public health-system access and reported deficiencies in infrastructure, personnel, medicines, equipment and basic services (water, electricity) at care points.
reports._notes: Lived health-system stress. Large majority rely on public facilities; independent diagnostics report widespread shortages of medicines, supplies, equipment and basic services inside those facilities. Private care is largely inaccessible by cost.

reports.title: Ingresos petroleros del Estado
reports.description: Fiscal and external revenues derived from oil exports. Primary financing source of the public sector and of foreign-exchange supply.
reports._notes: Core fiscal-revenue node. Recovery of production and commercialisation arrangements (including licensed private operators) directly shapes the government’s foreign-exchange and budget capacity. Transparency of flows remains limited.

reports.title: SENIAT — tax administration
reports.description: National tax authority. Publishes residual tax-collection statistics that form the non-oil revenue side of the budget.
reports._notes: Non-oil revenue node. Tax collection exists and is reported in residual form, but oil remains the dominant fiscal resource; the overall budget framework is characterised by limited transparency.

reports.title: Estado Anzoátegui — eastern oil and industrial
reports.description: Eastern state with significant oil and industrial activity. Intermediate-to-high living-condition stress in independent diagnostics.
reports._notes: Eastern oil/industrial geography. Completes the set of major hydrocarbon and population states.

reports.title: Régimen de sanciones de EE.UU. / OFAC Venezuela sanctions
reports.description: Comprehensive U.S. sanctions architecture targeting the Venezuelan government, PDVSA, the central bank and designated individuals/entities. Continuously amended by general licenses that carve out authorised oil, gas and related activities.
reports._notes: Dominant external constraint and enabling framework. The regime remains in force; policy has shifted toward incremental expansion of General License carve-outs rather than comprehensive lifting. Continuously cited as the binding condition for lawful commercial engagement with the oil sector.

reports.title: OFAC General Licenses (GL 46 / GL 50 and successors)
reports.description: Series of general licenses authorising named international oil companies and defined activities involving Venezuelan-origin oil, gas, petrochemicals and related investment. Core operational carve-out from the broader sanctions regime.
reports._notes: Operational enabler of the recent production recovery. Named majors are authorised to operate upstream and related activities under evolving license terms; royalty and revenue handling is subject to U.S.-controlled mechanisms.
_referenced_by: Chevron, BP, Shell, Eni, Repsol, Maurel & Prom operations

reports.title: Chevron — licensed oil operations in Venezuela
reports.description: Longest-standing U.S. major operating under successive OFAC licenses. Principal early channel for resumed commercial oil flows toward the United States.
reports._notes: Flagship licensed operator. Continuously cited as the bridge that kept a residual commercial link to the U.S. market during the tighter sanctions period and as a core participant under the broader 2026 general licenses.
reports._url_evidence: Chevron's official 'Venezuela Highlights of Operations' page, listing its PDVSA joint-venture interests (Petroboscán 39.2%, Petropiar 30%, Petroindependiente 25.2%, Petroindependencia/Carabobo 3 34%) and the Loran gas block.

reports.title: Majors licenciados (BP, Shell, Eni, Repsol, Maurel & Prom)
reports.description: Group of European and other international oil companies authorised under OFAC general licenses to conduct oil and gas operations in Venezuela alongside Chevron.
reports._notes: Expanded licensed-operator set. Their entry/return under the 2026 general licenses is a central feature of the post-transition commercial reopening of the upstream sector.

reports.title: Fondo / mecanismo de control de ingresos petroleros (EE.UU.)
reports.description: U.S.-controlled arrangements for the handling of certain Venezuelan oil-related revenues and royalty flows under the post-2026 sanctions and license architecture.
reports._notes: Critical revenue-governance node. Independent analysis tracks the share of export value that flows through U.S.-administered mechanisms versus direct government or PDVSA channels; transparency remains limited.
reports._url_evidence: OFAC's Venezuela-Related Sanctions program page; it lists the current oil-related general licences (GL 52A on PDVSA, 46C on Venezuelan-origin oil, 47A, 50B) and E.O. 14373 'Safeguarding Venezuelan Oil Revenue', the revenue-control framework described in the node.

reports.title: ALBA-TCP y Petrocaribe — residual architecture
reports.description: Bolivarian Alliance and Petrocaribe energy-cooperation frameworks that structured preferential oil supply and political alignment during the 2000s–2010s. Residual institutional and debt relationships persist.
reports._notes: Legacy supranational node. No longer the dominant commercial framework, but residual claims, political references and institutional memory remain relevant to Venezuela’s regional relationships.
_referenced_by: Caribbean and Central American debt-to-Venezuela discussions
reports._url_evidence: Official ALBA-TCP (Alianza Bolivariana para los Pueblos de Nuestra América) site with Comunicados, Actas, the Presidential/Political/Social/Economic Councils and Documentos sections; note petrocaribe.org is not official — it is now an unrelated small-business blog.

reports.title: Relación comercial petrolera Venezuela–EE.UU.
reports.description: Bilateral oil-trade relationship reconstituted under the licensed-operator regime. United States has re-emerged as a major (in some recent months the largest) destination for Venezuelan crude.
reports._notes: Structural commercial reorientation. Share of exports going to the U.S. has risen sharply relative to the China-dominated pattern of the preceding years.
reports._url_evidence: EIA series 'U.S. Imports from Venezuela of Crude Oil (Thousand Barrels per Day)', monthly, showing values through May 2026 (471 kb/d) with release date 7/31/2026 — the official U.S. statistical series for the bilateral oil trade.

reports.title: Relación comercial y de deuda con China
reports.description: Long-standing oil-for-loans and commercial relationship. China was the dominant export destination through the mid-2020s; volumes and relative weight have declined under the post-transition commercial reorientation.
reports._notes: Legacy and residual partner. Oil-backed debt and preferential supply arrangements defined a major external relationship for more than a decade; the commercial share has fallen as U.S.-licensed channels expanded.
reports._url_evidence: China's Ministry of Commerce country guide '对外投资合作国别（地区）指南 — 委内瑞拉' (2025 edition) on mofcom.gov.cn, covering China–Venezuela bilateral trade, Chinese investment and the 2023 all-weather strategic partnership; hosted on the publisher's own domain, not a mirror.

reports.title: Proyectos de gas (Loran, Cardón IV) — partnerships
reports.publisher: PDVSA / Shell / BP / Eni / Repsol / partners
reports.description: Key gas-development projects involving international partners (Shell, BP, Eni, Repsol and others) under the licensed or authorised framework. Includes cross-border fields with Trinidad and Tobago.
reports._notes: Gas-side international partnership node. Complements the oil-focused licensed-major set and illustrates the broader energy-sector reopening under the current sanctions-and-license architecture.
reports._url_evidence: Repsol's official Venezuela operations page describing the Perla field (Cardón IV) producing 580 MMcf/d plus Quiriquire Gas, Petrocarabobo and Petroquiriquire; it is a partner-publisher page — no PDVSA-domain page exists since pdvsa.com is offline.

dependencies.basis: Income poverty is calculated from the ENCOVI household income modules.
Multidimensional poverty is constructed from ENCOVI indicators across income, services, education and housing.
ENCOVI provides key estimates of residual population and migration effects on household structure.
The Orinoco Belt is the principal long-run resource base for production and reserves.
School coverage and attendance indicators are derived from ENCOVI.
Labour-force and employment indicators are derived from ENCOVI.
Health-access and perception indicators are drawn from ENCOVI and complementary independent diagnostics.
Oil-revenue flows are directly tied to production volumes and commercialisation arrangements.
Chevron’s operations are authorised under successive OFAC general licenses.
BP, Shell, Eni, Repsol and Maurel & Prom operate under the same general-license framework.
U.S. destination volumes are a direct function of licensed production and commercialisation.
China’s residual and historical offtake is a major component of the export-destination structure.

_dropped.why: Re-checked 2026-08-18 against primary sources and not supported. Searched the CLAP constitutional law text on asambleanacional.gob.ve and UCAB/ENCOVI poverty publications for any statement that CLAP administration draws on ENCOVI income-poverty figures, or that ENCOVI's pobreza de ingresos incorporates the CLAP box as imputed income. Nothing found in either direction: the CLAP law defines an organisational/distribution structure and cites no statistical input, and ENCOVI's income-poverty measure is monetary. The 'partially offsets low monetary income' claim is an analytical observation, not a documented dependency.

Dropped: "produced_by" is not a dependency type. The publisher of a report is a plain string on the report, never a node of its own (data spec 2c). Original basis: Official IPC is produced by the Banco Central de Venezuela.

Dropped: "produced_by" is not a dependency type. The publisher of a report is a plain string on the report, never a node of its own (data spec 2c). Original basis: PDVSA is the institutional producer of the bulk of Venezuelan crude.

Re-checked 2026-08-18 against primary sources and not supported. Fetched bcv.org.ve, which is live and publishes both the tipo de cambio and the IPC. No methodological note there states that the exchange-rate series is computed from the IPC or that the IPC is computed from the exchange rate; they are separately compiled BCV series. Exchange-rate pass-through into consumer prices is an economic relationship asserted by analysts, not a stated input dependency between the two BCV publications.

Re-checked 2026-08-18 against primary sources and not supported. The bonos/transferencias node has no URL of its own, and there is no official Venezuelan publication (Patria/Sistema Patria has no methodology page reachable) stating that the bonus programme uses ENCOVI income-poverty data for targeting, nor that ENCOVI's income-poverty aggregate is built from official bonus records. ENCOVI collects transfer receipt from respondents, not from state registers. Same thematic-offset pattern as drop_index 0.
Reverse-containment edge could not be moved onto the child node. Original basis: Miranda forms the principal demographic and economic periphery of the greater Caracas region.

Re-checked 2026-08-18 against primary sources and not supported. The source node ve-deuda-publica does not exist in the corpus (source_exists: false, no title, no URL), so there is no dependent to attach the edge to. Beyond that, the only documents that would state PDVSA's share of the public external-debt stock are PDVSA's own financial statements, which lived on pdvsa.com — a domain with no DNS record. Per the standing instruction I did not substitute a mirror or a news report.

Re-checked 2026-08-18 against primary sources and not supported. seniat.gob.ve does not respond, so SENIAT's own collection reports are unreachable, and the target (ingresos petroleros, bcv.org.ve) publishes oil revenue without naming tax collection as an input. Searches returned only press coverage of SENIAT collection totals (TalCual, swissinfo, Transparencia Venezuela), which I did not use. The asserted relation is in any case complementarity within total fiscal revenue, not one series being an input to the other.

Re-checked 2026-08-18 against primary sources and not supported. Fetched albatcp.org (the source node's own URL): the homepage hosts no Petrocaribe agreement, methodology or data note, and the site's own Petrocaribe article returns 404. The OLADE study 'Evolución del Acuerdo de Cooperación Energética PETROCARIBE' is 404, and the Nicaraguan INE copy of the bilateral Acuerdo is robots-blocked. Even if the treaty text were retrievable it would document a physical crude-supply arrangement, not a statement that the Petrocaribe node takes BCV oil-production figures as an input, method or citation — none of the four types would fit.

_consolidation.json_syntax_repair_note: These batch files were not valid JSON as delivered: "releases_per_year" carried an unquoted text value (missing opening quote), e.g. `"releases_per_year": continuous",`. Repaired mechanically by re-quoting the value verbatim. No number was invented.
_consolidation.cadence_note: A non-numeric cadence text was moved off releases_per_year into _cadence_original verbatim and the numeric field omitted, per the v2 spec (omitted, never null). Needs a human/judgement pass to become a real number.

_normalisation.note: Second pass, 2026-08-18: mechanical alignment to src/lib/types.ts. Nothing researched, nothing invented. Every original value that was replaced is preserved on the record under a key prefixed with an underscore.
rules: jurisdiction_level mapped into the six-value union; the delivered string kept as _jurisdiction_level_original.
domains: format-normalised, then any tag outside the 22 approved values prefixed "proposed:" as the spec directs. No semantic merging was done — that needs your call.

relationship_type: part_of edges moved onto the child node as part_of; contains edges reversed onto the child; produced_by edges dropped (publisher is a string, not a node); related_to / complements held in _dropped as deferred. Off-union values were poisoning every PageRank score with NaN.
last_updated added as null where absent (required field, string|null).
region filled with the country name where it was null or missing.
releases_per_year: unambiguous single-word cadences resolved to numbers; ambiguous text left in _cadence_original and listed under _gaps.unresolved_cadence.
source_kind mapped to official/commercial; delivered value kept as _source_kind_original.
Non-schema keys Grok wrote (shape, notes, referenced_by, ...) renamed with a leading underscore so they are visibly not part of the schema. Nothing deleted.

domain_semantic_pass.merged_into_existing: Synonyms folded into the 22 already-approved tags (prices→inflation, employment→labour, demography/census→population, monetary/central-bank→monetary-policy, gdp/grdp/regional-accounts→national-accounts, and so on).
domain_semantic_pass.promoted: 17 tags that had earned a slot were promoted out of proposed: and added to Domain in types.ts.
domain_semantic_pass.dropped: Geographic pseudo-tags (regional, provincial, urban, municipal, metropolitan) and batch-meta pseudo-tags (comprehensive, multi-domain, meta, indicators) were removed — geography is already carried by region and jurisdiction_level, and the meta ones describe the batch rather than the report.
